answer_1.quote: We use a pretrained language model to choose the best possible segmentation (i.e. the segmentation that gives the most probable plaintext according to the language model).
datasets: DECODE database (IA cipher, S304, C13, F283)

answer_2.quote: We follow  and use character-level Translation Edit Rate (TER) as our evaluation metric.
